pre_repair_ui:
Ansel · millwright
Repair and test the headrace gate

Fit a timber brace and test the gate. Ansel can keep the mill track dry for Fenna’s load.

Cost: 2 timber · you carry 2. Spent only when you choose the repair.

CURRENT · JAMMED
A gate caught low

The leaf sits low in its guides, the brace is twisted and the wheel is still.

AFTER YOUR REPAIR
A braced, lifted gate

Five timber planks, iron straps and a new brace hold the raised leaf. The mill wheel can turn again.

Your completed repair will remain here when you return. The watercourse stays off the walking route. Viewing the work earns no extra payment.

Spend 2 timber · repair & test
